The '''Coruscant Merchants' Guild''' was a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] group active by [[11,987 BBY]] that shared its name with the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscant-born]] [[Gender/Legends|man]] [[Contispex I/Legends|Contispex I]], who became [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] in 11,987 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], first rose to prominence as a member of the Coruscant Merchants' Guild. There, he achieved fame for his opposition to corruption and those who did not share his moral standards, as well as his devotion to the [[Pius Dea]] religion which had originated on Coruscant in the [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before 11,987 BBY.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Coruscant Merchants' Guild was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="Warfare" />
